thread_text:
mia: Heads-up: Verdant is ready for a case study interview next Tue 11am PT. They want a webinar tie-in and a brief benchmark snapshot in the blog. Need legal release and metric sign-off by Fri EOD.

 tom: Nice. Can we confirm the webinar slot is 45m? Proposed flow: 15m customer story, 15m demo w/ engineer, 10m panel q&a, 5m CTA.

 rachel_legal: Please send the customer legal entity and point of contact. Also confirm if were using any verbatim performance numbers (latency/throughput). If so, require written data-source confirmation.

 mia: Contact: Verdant Labs LLC, contact: Marco Diaz (Head of ML). Theyre ok with public blog + webinar recording. CCd their legal on the release email.

 josh_prod: Production note: well capture a short 30s clip for socials and a 2-slide benchmark graphic. Need any raw logs or perf artifacts by Thu so design can iterate.

 evan_eng: We ran their workload on Redwood Dedicated (2x H100). Median latency 48ms at 512 tokens in our test harness. We can provide anonymized run logs.

 tom: For the blog benchmark sidebar, can we include relative improvement vs their previous stack? Marco suggested ~2.1x faster after cutover. Need to verify.

 rachel_legal: Marco or their engineering lead must confirm the comparative claim in email. Also prefer "around 2x" phrasing to avoid overly precise public statements.

 mia: Draft quote for Marco to approve: "Migrating to Redwood let us serve suggestions in real time, reducing latency by around 2x and improving developer iteration." Thoughts?
 tom: Tight. Suggest: replace "developer iteration" with "time-to-iterate".
 evan_eng: Suggest minor tweak to metrics line: "reducing median latency by ~2x for 512-token requests" so its clear what the number refers to.
 rachel_legal: OK but we need that exact line confirmed by Marco. I'll attach our release template and request explicit metric approval in the same email thread.

 campaign-bot: Reminder: set campaign utm_campaign=verdant-case-2025 and add campaign tag in HubSpot workflow.

 mia: Whos owning inbound routing from the webinar signups? I want to route product-trial-intent leads to sales_eng@ and demo-requests to AEs.
 josh_prod: I'll wire HubSpot form field mapping: intent=trial -> sales_eng@, intent=demo -> ae-na@. Also add "source=webinar_verdant" property.

 mia: Great. Also create a content gate to collect 1) company name 2) use-case 3) monthly active users. That helps qualify leads.
 tom: I'll prep landing copy and a short CTA we can A/B test. Two variants: "See Redwood in your stack" vs "Schedule a dedicated demo".

 rachel_legal: Quick procedural note: if were embedding the webinar recording on a public blog, we need the signed release AND a permission checkbox in the HubSpot form for repurposing quotes.
 mia: Understood. I'll add that field and include consent language.
 evan_eng: On the benchmark graphic: do we want absolute numbers (ms) or relative multipliers? Absolute is better for transparency but legal might prefer relative.
 rachel_legal: We can do both if Verdant signs off on absolute numbers. Otherwise use relative + note "based on internal performance tests".

 mia: Timeline check: legal sign-off by Fri, design assets by Mon, webinar on Tue, publish blog + benchmark + recording the following Wed. Everyone good?
 josh_prod: Blockers: need anonymized run logs by Thu 5pm PT and Marco's metric confirmation in writing.
 tom: Also need headshot and short bio (1-2 sentences) from Marco for the byline.
 mia: Marco just DM'd: hell provide bio + sign metric confirmation in email today.
 rachel_legal: Received Marcos confirmation at 16:12. He approves the quote as drafted and confirms the median latency numbers are accurate. Signed release attached. :white_check_mark:
 mia: Perfect. Moving to scheduling + asset creation. I'll follow up with final copy for review by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all! :rocket:
